newsitem.title: CYPRUS: SOCCER-CYPRUS MATCH DISRUPTED AFTER REFEREE ATTACKED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CYPRUS MATCH DISRUPTED AFTER REFEREE ATTACKED.

text.p: A referee had to take cover in an ambulance on Sunday night after fans invaded the pitch in protest at his sending off an Omonia player during a match with Salamina.
The match was disrupted then abandoned two minutes before the end when Omonia player Costas Malekkos was ordered off the pitch by referee Costas Kapitanis. The score stood at 3-2 in Omonia's favour.
Angry fans chased Kapitanis who jumped into an ambulance, waiting to take a Salmania player to hospital.
Football officials said the disciplinary commission of Cyprus's Football Association would decide whether there should be a rematch.
